"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"When socialists are elected, they can popularize demands, legislate to increase working class power, and expose the repressive mechanisms of bourgeois democracy from within.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Socialists' offices can become sites of community organization when they are elected.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Emerge does not equate a seat at the table with actual power in an inherently hostile state.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Independent movements are needed to open space for elected socialists to operate, through applying external pressure and bolstering defense from reactionary forces.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
